author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Aryna Sabalenka and Elena Rybakina will meet in Saturday’s U.S. Open women’s final, pairing two of the sport’s biggest servers in a championship match with rankings and history attached. Sabalenka is seeking a third consecutive title in New York, a run no woman has completed since Serena Williams won three straight through 2014.

Rybakina is set to become world No. 1 when the rankings are updated Monday, regardless of the final’s outcome. The match will be the third Grand Slam final between the two. Sabalenka won their 2023 Australian Open title match, while Rybakina reversed that result at this year’s Australian Open.

Sabalenka leads their head-to-head series 10-7, but the margins have often been narrow because both players can shorten points with first-strike tennis. The contrast is less about power than temperament and execution under pressure: Sabalenka brings an expressive, aggressive style, while Rybakina is known for a more restrained presence. Their latest meeting will decide the season’s final major and add another chapter to one of the tour’s defining rivalries.
dek: Aryna Sabalenka seeks a third consecutive New York title against Elena Rybakina, who is due to become world No. 1 after the tournament.
headline: Sabalenka and Rybakina set heavyweight U.S. Open final
